name: connectcampaignsv2
description: Provide APIs to create and manage Amazon Connect Campaigns.

subcommands.name: create-campaign
subcommands.description: Creates a campaign for the specified Amazon Connect account.

subcommands.name: delete-campaign
subcommands.description: Deletes a campaign from the specified Amazon Connect account.

subcommands.name: delete-campaign-channel-subtype-config
subcommands.description: Deletes the channel subtype config of a campaign.

subcommands.name: delete-campaign-communication-limits
subcommands.description: Deletes the communication limits config for a campaign.

subcommands.name: delete-campaign-communication-time
subcommands.description: Deletes the communication time config for a campaign.

subcommands.name: delete-campaign-entry-limits
subcommands.description: Deletes the entry limits config for a campaign.

subcommands.name: delete-connect-instance-config
subcommands.description: Deletes a connect instance config from the specified AWS account.

subcommands.name: delete-connect-instance-integration
subcommands.description: Delete the integration for the specified Amazon Connect instance.

subcommands.name: delete-instance-onboarding-job
subcommands.description: Delete the Connect Campaigns onboarding job for the specified Amazon Connect instance.

subcommands.name: describe-campaign
subcommands.description: Describes the specific campaign.

subcommands.name: get-campaign-state
subcommands.description: Get state of a campaign for the specified Amazon Connect account.

subcommands.name: get-campaign-state-batch
subcommands.description: Get state of campaigns for the specified Amazon Connect account.

subcommands.name: get-connect-instance-config
subcommands.description: Get the specific Connect instance config.

subcommands.name: get-instance-communication-limits
subcommands.description: Get the instance communication limits.

subcommands.name: get-instance-onboarding-job-status
subcommands.description: Get the specific instance onboarding job status.

subcommands.name: list-campaigns
subcommands.description: Provides summary information about the campaigns under the specified Amazon Connect account.

subcommands.name: list-connect-instance-integrations
subcommands.description: Provides summary information about the integration under the specified Connect instance.

subcommands.name: list-tags-for-resource
subcommands.description: List tags for a resource.

subcommands.name: pause-campaign
subcommands.description: Pauses a campaign for the specified Amazon Connect account.

subcommands.name: put-connect-instance-integration
subcommands.description: Put or update the integration for the specified Amazon Connect instance.

subcommands.name: put-instance-communication-limits
subcommands.description: Put the instance communication limits.

subcommands.name: put-outbound-request-batch
subcommands.description: Creates outbound requests for the specified campaign Amazon Connect account.

subcommands.name: put-profile-outbound-request-batch
subcommands.description: Takes in a list of profile outbound requests to be placed as part of an outbound campaign.

subcommands.name: resume-campaign
subcommands.description: Stops a campaign for the specified Amazon Connect account.

subcommands.name: start-campaign
subcommands.description: Starts a campaign for the specified Amazon Connect account.

subcommands.name: start-instance-onboarding-job
subcommands.description: Onboard the specific Amazon Connect instance to Connect Campaigns.

subcommands.name: stop-campaign
subcommands.description: Stops a campaign for the specified Amazon Connect account.

subcommands.name: tag-resource
subcommands.description: Tag a resource.

subcommands.name: untag-resource
subcommands.description: Untag a resource.

subcommands.name: update-campaign-channel-subtype-config
subcommands.description: Updates the channel subtype config of a campaign.

subcommands.name: update-campaign-communication-limits
subcommands.description: Updates the communication limits config for a campaign.

subcommands.name: update-campaign-communication-time
subcommands.description: Updates the communication time config for a campaign.

subcommands.name: update-campaign-entry-limits
subcommands.description: Updates the entry limits config for a campaign.

subcommands.name: update-campaign-flow-association
subcommands.description: Updates the campaign flow associated with a campaign.

subcommands.name: update-campaign-name
subcommands.description: Updates the name of a campaign.

subcommands.name: update-campaign-schedule
subcommands.description: Updates the schedule for a campaign.

subcommands.name: update-campaign-source
subcommands.description: Updates the campaign source with a campaign.
